items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: You know, like Harold Dajon, Andrew Morgan, John Handley, and I'm surprised.

ctx.x: He was a wonderful clarinet player, Johnny Handley. He was a wonderful clarinet player. Everybody likes to hear him play clarinet plays. But he put the clarinet down and after he heard me with that sax he didn't have nothing with that clarinet anymore. And the poor fellow he died but he never could get back to his clarinet again.
Yeah, that happens to a lot of you. I'm surprised that didn't happen to you. You know, like Harold Dajon, Andrew Morgan, John Handley, and I'm surprised.

Well Morgan got him attacked. He came to me, Andrew, and take my lessons on the sax. Really? Yeah, Andrew Morgan. Because he was fooling with the clarinet too. But everybody was enthused over it. Everything was Paul Barnes, Paul Barnes. They quit calling me Pullo. Oh they did?
